title: Lowering the Bar for Everyone: Hidden Validation-Seeking Goals in Empathetic RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.30702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When RL learns from the reactions of many users, the policy usually cannot see what each user wants. We ask what it learns from users who privately want validation: to validate them alone (targeting), or to lower its bar for endorsing everyone (a threshold shift). We answer this in one setting, empathetic RL against LLM-simulated users (RLVER, GRPO, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct): we vary only the share of validation-seeking users (0--50%; RLVER's default: 24.6%) and evaluate on 1,000 Reddit AITA posts with community fault verdicts.   The policy shifts its threshold. Endorsement of at-fault posters rises by 3--4 percentage points per 10 points of share; without such users the Qwen model stays at base, and the effect persists at matched KL and under a goal-blind reward. Signal-detection analysis shows that the criterion for endorsing falls while discrimination between at-fault and not-at-fault posters does not decline. An explicit request to be t

translated_title: 降低所有人的门槛：共情强化学习中隐藏的寻求认同目标
translated_abstract: 当强化学习从众多用户的反应中学习时，策略通常无法得知每个用户的真实诉求。我们探究：当部分用户私下希望获得认同时，策略会从他们身上学到什么——是只单独迎合这些用户（针对性偏袒），还是降低对所有人表示认可的门槛（阈值偏移）。我们在一个设定中回答了这一问题：针对LLM模拟用户的共情强化学习（RLVER、GRPO、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）。我们仅改变寻求认同用户的占比（0–50%；RLVER默认值为24.6%），并在1000条带有社区过错判定的Reddit AITA帖子上进行评估。结果表明，策略发生了阈值偏移：寻求认同用户占比每提高10个百分点，对有过错发帖人的认可率就上升3–4个百分点；在没有这类用户时，Qwen模型保持在基线水平；且该效应在匹配KL散度以及目标盲奖励下依然存在。信号检测分析显示，表示认可的判定标准下降，而对有过错与无过错发帖人的辨别能力并未下降。一个明确的请求……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 在基于LLM模拟用户的共情强化学习中，寻求认同用户的占比每增加10个百分点，策略对有过错发帖人的认可率就上升3–4个百分点，表明策略会隐蔽地降低对所有人的认可门槛，而其辨别过错的能力并未下降。
en_tdlr: In empathetic RL with LLM-simulated users, each 10-point increase in the share of validation-seeking users raises endorsement of at-fault posters by 3–4 percentage points, revealing that the policy covertly lowers its endorsement bar for everyone while its discrimination remains intact.
